content.short: Solarplex is a Solana-focused Product Hunt-like platform for Web3 product builders.
content.description: Solarplex is designed to serve the needs of Web3 product builder communities with a social platform that leverages thoughtful design and the unique capabilities of Web3. It helps users discover cutting-edge projects, news, and resources across supported chains; test products with real users and collect high-quality feedback; and connect with project teams, founders, and other members of the ecosystem. In short, Solarplex is a collaborative space for builders to share ideas, iterate, and gain community feedback.
content.meta: Solarplex is a social platform for Web3 product builders. Discover Solarplex and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
